case_traceability: Each checklist item must remain traceable to one or more Table III cases (bidirectional checklist-case link). If the case citation is removed, the item must not remain a generic injunction true of any IAM estate.
sync_note: Item text here must remain byte-identical in meaning to manuscript Table IV. Items 3 and 8 were corrected in v1.0.7: item 3 no longer implies that a single-node primitive is the production control, and item 8 no longer prescribes a buffer default, matching the manuscript Section VII statement that the checklist states the operational validation action without prescribing a single buffer default.

items.item: Treat IdP success and edge release as separate steps; require acknowledgment before commit, or compensating rollback.
Do not key device caps on randomized MACs; use stable bindings and remediation user experience.

Implement a linearizable, single-winner consume operation for the edge callback-correlation value or callback capability at the callback-consistency scope; document the state store's replication, failover, and partition behaviour; fail closed (reject the callback) when the consume outcome is uncertain; and configure the value's TTL for the maximum expected authorization round trip plus operational margin.
items.note: Redis GETDEL is one single-node example of such a primitive and is used illustratively in Fig. 3. It is not the required control. Single-node atomicity does not establish cluster-wide safety under replication or failover.

items.item: Document two session planes; never skip edge re-authorization because SSO is warm.
Size federation timeouts for worst-site WAN, not LAN HA assumptions; plan degrade messaging.
Validate sticky routing and shared session stores across sites; expect re-authentication windows on failover.
Treat IdP cluster coherence as an authentication health check; quorum runbooks; no dual-writer under partition.

Validate representative end-to-end SAML and OIDC request sizes against the deployed gateway version and configuration, including request limits, buffering behaviour, and timeouts; alert on gateway rejection, malformed federation payloads, and timeout termination.
items.note: No buffer default is prescribed. harness/fixtures/i4/ provides synthetic size-class fixtures for local validation only.

items.item: Provide at least one alternative authenticator that does not depend on SMS/PSTN delivery; do not make SMS the sole MFA completion path for affected users.
Run a dual-IdP equivalence checklist before cutover (token shape, claims, lifetimes).
